assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production PNG sprite animation strip for an original 2D top-down game. The attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Use ONLY its exhausted paper-puppet characters: thick irregular near-black ink contour, flat recycled-paper cream and muted tobacco-yellow fills, one cel-shadow maximum, funny heavy-lidded eyes and tiny resigned mouth. Four equal-width cells in ONE horizontal row, transparent RGBA canvas, a wide 3:1 image. NO cell borders or labels. Exactly FOUR complete copies of the SAME character, one per quarter at x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Same body size and foot baseline at 87% height, each confined inside its quarter with 10% side clearance. Frame 0 neutral idle, frame 1 left foot steps forward with body weight left, frame 2 right foot steps forward with body weight right, frame 3 briefly squashed/creased from a hit. Feet and arms visibly change, but the identity stays identical. Full body all four cells, no clipping. Camera slightly elevated three-quarter view, front-facing toward down-right. NO weapons, guns, props held in hands, ground, cast shadow, glow, text, metallic armor, robots or photorealism. Genuine transparent background, not a checkerboard drawn into the image. SUBJECT: Looper, the ordinary tired rectangular creased paper doll from the left side of the reference. One bent top-right corner, asymmetrical folded square head/body, deadpan half-lidded eyes, little paper arms and short black stub feet. A tiny blank worn identification tag hangs on its chest. A small folded paper-feed satchel is visible at one side, not larger than its body. Pale cream dominates. Keep exactly the same face in all four frames.
